jobs.title: VP, Product Delivery & Growth - AI
jobs.description:
Job Title:
VP, Product Delivery & Growth - AI

Location:
Canada - Remote or Mississauga, ON - Hybrid

Travel to Office expectations**

For Remote Roles
: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.

For Hybrid Roles
: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.

At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.

With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.

At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.

Join us in redefining healthcare , so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.

About The Team

The Integrated Care + SNF Reimbursement portfolio spans the connected workflows that carry a resident from referral through care delivery to payment: including, acute and payer care collaboration on the National Care Collaboration Network and Audacious platforms, Secure Conversations across our customer segments, practitioner EHR solutions, SNF admissions and managed care workflows, and SNF revenue cycle and reimbursement optimization.

The Outbound Product Management team within this portfolio is the bridge between strategic customer relationships, go-to-market execution, and product direction. The team is remote and hybrid across the US and Canada, and works shoulder to shoulder with inbound Product Management, Engineering, and every GTM function.

Position Summary

This role owns product delivery and growth for the Integrated Care + SNF Reimbursement portfolio, carrying accountability for how validated offerings reach the market and convert into adoption, revenue, and reference customers. The VP defines and drives end-to-end go-to-market strategy across the portfolio, co-owns roadmap and investment decisions with inbound Product Management, and owns the commercial model — pricing, packaging, and monetization — for new and AI-enabled capabilities.

The VP leads the portfolio's Outbound Product Management function, building and developing the team that runs launch, enablement, and early adoption. They represent PointClickCare’s product function externally as a market figurehead with SNF, payer, practitioner, and acute customers and across the industry, and internally as a trusted advisor to the SVP, Product Management and the GTM leadership team.

Success is measured in growth outcomes: revenue and adoption attainment against portfolio targets, speed from launch to first reference customer, and the repeatable sales motions that turn early wins into scale.

Key Responsibilities

Go-To-Market Strategy & Portfolio Growth: Own end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the portfolio from launch through scale. Define the growth thesis for each product line, set adoption and revenue targets with Sales and Revenue Operations, and drive cross-functional accountability for attainment.
Commercial Model & Monetization: Lead pricing, packaging, and monetization strategy for new and AI-enabled capabilities, including usage-based pricing, tiered access, and enterprise licensing. Partner with Pricing, Finance, and Revenue Operations on scalable models that protect margin.
Product Strategy & Roadmap: Partner with inbound Product Management leaders to shape portfolio direction, translating customer feedback, competitive signals, and adoption data into roadmap and investment recommendations. Serve as the commercial voice in portfolio planning and trade-off decisions.
Executive Customer Engagement & Market Leadership: Build executive relationships across strategic SNF, payer, practitioner, and acute accounts. Lead beta and co-development programs that generate real-world proof points, and represent PointClickCare with customers, industry bodies, and analysts.
Organizational Leadership & Talent Development: Lead and grow the Outbound Product Management function, including leaders of teams. Hire, coach, and develop talent, establish operating cadence and standards aligned with the product development lifecycle and go-to-market model, and foster accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Portfolio Performance & Market Insight: Define and track portfolio, customer engagement, and go-to-market KPIs. Lead competitive analysis, customer research, and thought leadership, and partner with legal, compliance, and governance teams to support responsible deployment of AI-enabled capabilities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

12+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, or product growth, including 5+ years leading teams at the Director level or above.
Demonstrated ownership of go-to-market strategy for a multi-product portfolio, with accountability for adoption and revenue outcomes beyond launch execution.
Proven success building commercial models for SaaS and AI-enabled products, including pricing, packaging, and monetization, with fluency in ARR, NRR, CAC, LTV, and churn.
Executive presence and demonstrated ability to influence and align senior leaders across Sales, Sales Enablement, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Solutions, Pricing, and Professional Services.
Experience leading leaders, including hiring, developing, and scaling teams through organizational change.
Strong data-driven decision-making skills, using qualitative and quantitative signals to set priorities and make defensible trade-offs.
Ability to travel regularly to strategic customer sites and industry events, with occasional travel to PointClickCare offices.

Preferred Experience

Background in post-acute care, senior care, or payer-provider collaboration models.
Experience taking AI-enabled products to market, including generative AI, large language model, and agentic capabilities.
Familiarity with interoperability, care transitions, and referral and authorization workflows.

At PointClickCare, base salary is one of the many components that make up our total rewards package. This role offers a competitive base salary+ bonus + benefits, non-overtime eligible. Our salary ranges are determined by job and level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by job-related skills and knowledge, relevant experience including professional and lived experience, and/or work location. Your recruiter can share more information about our total rewards package during the hiring process.

PointClickCare Benefits & Perks

Benefits starting from Day 1
Retirement Plan Matching (RRSP & 401K)
Flexible Paid Time Off
Lifestyle/Wellness Spending Account
Parental & Caregiver Leaves
Fertility & Adoption Support
Continuous Development Support Program
Employee Assistance Program
Learning Programs & Resources
Employee Recognition … and more!

Equal Employment Opportunity

It is the policy of PointClickCare to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, religion, national origin, status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law. PointClickCare welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Please contact recruitment@pointclickcare.com should you require any accommodations.

When you apply for a position, your information is processed and stored with Lever, in accordance with Lever’s Privacy Policy. We use this information to evaluate your candidacy for the posted position. We also store this information, and may use it in relation to future positions to which you apply, or which we believe may be relevant to you given your background. When we have no ongoing legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. If you have any questions about how PointClickCare uses or processes your information, or if you would like to ask to access, correct, or delete your information, please contact PointClickCare’s human resources team: recruitment@pointclickcare.com

PointClickCare is committed to Information Security. By applying to this position, if hired, you commit to following our information security policies and procedures and making every effort to secure confidential and/or sensitive information.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. We are aware of fraudulent recruitment activities in which individuals may falsely claim to represent PointClickCare, advertise fake job opportunities, or request personal or financial information. Please be aware that: All PointClickCare employment opportunities are posted on our official careers website. PointClickCare will never ask candidates to pay fees, purchase equipment, transfer money, or provide banking information during the recruiting process. Our recruiters communicate through official PointClickCare email addresses. Employment offers are only made following a formal interview and selection process. As part of our commitment to hiring security, candidates may be asked to verify their identity during the interview and onboarding process. Protect your information. If something feels suspicious, verify it before proceeding.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product Strategy (AI, Data, Advertising)
jobs.description:
Publicis Groupe Canada
is the Canadian subsidiary of Publicis Groupe, the second largest communications group in the world and a global leader concentrated within four main activities: Communication, Media, Data and Technology. Publicis Groupe Canada represents the vision of a set of collaborative and integrated agencies that offer expertise and insightful services to many of the biggest brands in North America.

Canadian brands include:
Publicis Canada (Publicis Canada, Hawkeye, Razorfish, Publicis Health, ThePubProductions, Nurun, Moov AI, Publicis Sports & Entertainment), Publicis Media (Starcom, Spark Foundry, Zenith), Leo Burnett (Leo Burnett Canada, Ove Brand Design, Leo Burnett Design), Saatchi & Saatchi (Saatchi & Saatchi Canada, Synergize, TPM), MSL Canada/North Strategic and Publicis Sapient.

Overview

The Senior Director, Product Strategy
owns the vision and product roadmap strategy for Connected Solutions (Publicis Groupe’s AI & Data core products). They act as the bridge between client business needs and product capability: turning strategic priorities into a structured, sequenced business roadmap, and holding the line between strategic planning, tactical product design, and execution.

They are a product champion and strategic storyteller, representing Connected Solutions in client-facing pitches, senior presentations, and internal alignment discussions. Ultimately, this person turns individual client opportunities into scalable commercial momentum, and ensures Publicis Groupe’s Connected Solutions evolve in response to client needs.

Core Responsibilities

Roadmap Ownership:
Own the roadmap and rollout sequencing for core agentic solution, and identify adjacent products to grow around the core solution.
Roadmap Prioritization:
Establish clear prioritization criteria for roadmap decisions, balancing client demand, product feasibility, commercial potential, and strategic fit.
Business-to-Technical Bridge:
Set the high-level product vision and desired user experience, then partner with the Product Lead to translate it into an executable plan with Delivery & Technology.
Adoption & Impact
: Define what successful rollout looks like: identifying the adoption signals, client outcomes, and repeatable use cases that indicate potential for scale.
Feedback Loop Management:
Capture friction and adoption signals from clients and agencies, feeding them back into business roadmap prioritization.

Growth and Market Positioning.
Identify & shape growth opportunities within existing and prospective client relationships.
Storytelling & Demos:
Shape and present the business narrative for internal and client-facing moments, translating solution capability into a compelling story that stakeholders, clients, and agencies can act on. Represent Connected Solutions in pitches, senior presentations, demos, and strategic growth conversations.
Client Support:
Support account leads with rollout across priority Publicis Groupe clients. Serve as primary point of escalation for product-related issues, concerns, or strategic pivots; coordinating resolution in partnership with Product Lead.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Deep understanding of the agency ecosystem, ideally with experience across creative, media, and CRM disciplines.
Skilled at translating strategic priorities into terms technical leadership can act on, and vice versa.
Comfortable owning business strategy and rollout sequencing without owning or dictating technical architecture.
AI-fluent; understands where and how agentic AI and automation actually drive efficiency in marketing and media workflows.
Commercially-minded: thinks in terms of packaging, adoption, and client/agency value, not just features.
Strong communicator who can align business stakeholders, clients, agencies, and technical leadership at once.
Comfortable in front of C-level clients and internal executives.

Required Qualifications

BA/BS in Business, Marketing, or a related strategy discipline.
8+ years in product or marketing strategy, ideally within marketing/media agency environments.
Demonstrated expertise in marketing workflows and where AI/agentic solutions create efficiency (e.g., campaign optimization, insight generation, audience planning).
Experience building business roadmaps and rollout strategies for external clients or agency networks.

Preferred / Stand-Out Experience

Experience rolling out agentic AI or automation solutions within marketing or media organizations.
Familiarity with client and agency commercial models (licensing, packaging, service tiers).
Background partnering with technical/engineering leadership without owning technical delivery.
Experience running product advisory boards or structured client workshops.
New business / growth experience.

Additional Information

Eligibility: Candidates must be based in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), possess valid Canadian work authorization, and be willing to commute to our downtown Toronto office.
Hybrid schedule: Rotating 2-day / 3-day in-office schedule (Tue/Thu one week, Mon/Wed/Fri the next).
Competitive annual vacation program, enhanced between Christmas and New Year’s when our offices are closed.
Extended statutory holidays (we give our employees the Mondays and Fridays of provincial holidays so you can enjoy long 4-day weekends).
6 sick days per year and 2 personal days per year.
Monthly cell phone allowance
Employer RRSP matching contributions of up to 2%
“Work Your World” program, allowing you to work remotely for up to 6 weeks in any country where we have an office (50+ countries).
Comprehensive group insurance benefits (medical and dental care, vision care, psychological and paramedical services, disability insurance, fertility support, and gender-affirming care).
Internal support and guidance program for cancer, fertility, and gender transition.

The salary for this position is $160,000 - $200,000 per year. Actual compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and applicable certifications. This reflects what we reasonably expect to offer based on current market data.

We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process. These tools assist our recruitment team but never replace human decision-making. We believe in a human-first approach, where your experience and potential are recognized by people.

Publicis Canada is committed to building a diverse workforce representative of our community. We encourage and are pleased to consider all qualified candidates, without regard to race, colour, citizenship, religion, sex, marital / family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, aboriginal status, age, disability or persons who may require an accommodation, to apply. If you require a specific accommodation, please contact Human Resources at inquiries@publicisna.com.

Technology, Information and Media and Advertising Services
